verdict: M280 is a valid scoped frozen-trace opportunity and INT8 pre-scale accumulator-error DSE. A clean implementation that imports none of the M280, M251, or M43 producer analyzers independently rehashes and decodes all 40 M248 raw payloads, reconstructs 51,840,000 partition vectors, applies the M77 train-only centers with the required minimum-packed-value nearest tie-break, consumes the four M256 I-KY-KX-O INT8 payloads, and exactly reproduces every reported work, per-operator, wide/shared cycle, and weighted accumulator-error field. Tau zero exactly reproduces M251. Tau 2, 3, and 4 exceed 2x versus bit sparse only on the specialized WIDE144 PWP service; SHARED96 reaches at most 1.7164x. No lossy threshold is accuracy-admitted, RTL-backed, energy-backed, or a system result. Tau 2 is especially fragile: its 2.000245x wide result has only 33,304 candidate-cycle headroom to the exact 2x boundary, or 1.927 cycles per phase over 17,280 phases.

tie_break_attack.interpretation: The minimum packed uint16 tie-break is semantically material. A catalog-order implementation would preserve Hamming work but change snapped numerical outputs.

findings.title: Every speed-bearing threshold is lossy and still lacks network accuracy admission
findings.evidence: Tau 2 snaps 7,755,016 partition vectors (14.9595% of the full trace), with weighted pre-scale INT8 accumulator MAE 29.1389, RMS 37.8612, and worst per-row maximum 254. Tau 3 and 4 snap 19.1743% and 20.8658% with still larger error. M280 executes neither modified-forward S10 nor paired running-BN valid825.
findings.required_fix: Run exact snapped modified-forward S10 and paired running-BN valid825 against the identical PAFT checkpoint. Enforce the declared absolute AEE increase <=0.02 gate before selecting any tau above zero.

findings.title: The 2x result depends on a specialized wide PWP service that has no hardware cost closure
findings.evidence: Tau 2/3/4 reach 2.0002x/2.4114x/2.7274x only for WIDE144_PWP_96_WEIGHT, which serves a 144-byte PWP vector in one cycle while retaining one-cycle 96-byte weight service. SHARED96 reaches only 1.4275x/1.5948x/1.7164x. There is no integrated RTL, DC, timing, area, energy, or SRAM-port evidence for the wide service.
findings.required_fix: Keep wide and shared results in separate columns. Implement and synthesize the selected wide matcher/PWP path, including table/read bandwidth and tie-break, before treating the wide cycle point as hardware performance.

findings.title: Tau 2's nominal 2x crossing is too fragile to carry a headline
findings.evidence: The exact 2x boundary is 271,396,240 candidate cycles; tau 2 reports 271,362,936, only 33,304 cycles below it across 17,280 phases, or 1.927 cycles per phase. Unmodeled lookup, tie resolution, control, or memory effects can erase the crossing. The result is also isolated to four Conv layers and cannot imply network speedup.
findings.required_fix: Do not promote tau 2 as a robust 2x point. Add a sensitivity row with matcher/PWP/control overhead, and use tau 3 or 4 only if accuracy and synthesized hardware both pass.

findings.title: Tie-break behavior is numerically material but not yet an implemented protocol
findings.evidence: The full trace has 38,903,617 weighted vectors with multiple nearest centers; catalog-first would select a different center for 28,730,267. At tau 2, 1,904,483 snapped rows would change center under catalog-first. The independent minimum-value policy matches M280, but no RTL proves it.
findings.required_fix: Make minimum packed uint16 an RTL-visible comparator rule and add directed equal-distance tests before numerical equivalence or cycle admission.

findings.title: The signed delta direction is implicit
findings.evidence: M280 computes value-minus-center, hence exact-minus-snapped accumulator delta. All published error metrics are absolute, RMS, zero fraction, or maximum and therefore sign-invariant, so current numbers are unaffected; a later signed-bias metric could silently reverse interpretation.
findings.required_fix: Name the convention exact_minus_snapped in future receipts and report its negation explicitly when discussing snapped-output bias.

findings.title: Full means one frozen ten-sample single-sequence cohort
findings.evidence: All 51,840,000 partitions come from ten samples of zurich_city_09_a and four PAFT-ep4 bottleneck Conv layers. They are full for M248, not cross-sequence or valid825 coverage.
findings.required_fix: Retain PAFT-ep4/running-BN/s10/single-sequence qualifiers on every work, error, and cycle claim.

findings.title: The original M280 result was not delivered as a sealed replay bundle
findings.evidence: The author result directory contains only the result JSON. Identity is fail-closed inside the contract/analyzer, but no author RUN_MANIFEST, receipt, or replay log accompanies it.
findings.required_fix: Use the M283 clean-replay evidence and seal for review. Add a non-mutating author delivery manifest if M280 is cited directly.

allowed_claims: An independent implementation reconstructs all 51,840,000 M248 partition vectors and exactly matches M280 work, per-operator, cycle, and weighted INT8 accumulator-error results.
Tau zero exactly reproduces the lossless M251 work and cycle model.
On the frozen isolated-Conv model, tau 2, 3, and 4 reach 2.000245x, 2.411370x, and 2.727431x versus bit sparse on the specialized WIDE144 service.
On SHARED96, tau 2, 3, and 4 reach 1.427545x, 1.594758x, and 1.716418x; none reaches 2x.
Zero and singleton partitions are never snapped, and the minimum-packed-value nearest tie-break exactly matches the author result.
The published accumulator-error statistics are occurrence weighted and use the declared I-KY-KX-O signed INT8 weight layout.
forbidden_claims: Any lossy tau preserves S10 or valid825 accuracy
Tau 2 is a robust hardware 2x result
The WIDE144 cycle point includes synthesized bandwidth, area, timing, or energy cost
M280 proves integrated Conv, network, Local, Motion, or system speedup
M280 is RTL, PPA, energy, or DATE-headline ready
The 51,840,000 population is cross-sequence or valid825 coverage
next_gate: Run snapped modified-forward S10 for tau 2/3/4 with exact minimum-value tie-break.
Run paired running-BN valid825 and apply the declared <=0.02 absolute AEE increase gate.
Only for an accuracy-passing tau, implement the WIDE144 matcher/PWP/tie-break path and close Synopsys VCS plus matched DC/STA/energy as claimed.
